title: Key shapes
description: The shapes of keys that a scan for keys looks for: a prefix, then a token of min to max characters of the alphabet. The names are unique, and min is at most max.

name.description: Which key the shape is the form of, in at most 48 printable ASCII characters.

prefix.description: The text that every key of the shape starts with, in 1 to 32 printable ASCII characters without a space.

any_case.description: true compares the ASCII letters of the prefix in any case. The alphabet is compared as it is.

blank.description: true requires 1 to 16 spaces or tabs between the prefix and the token.

alphabet.description: The characters of the token: single printable ASCII characters and ranges such as A-Z. A - that starts no range is the character itself.

min.description: How many characters of the alphabet the token has at least.

max.description: How many characters of the token a find covers at most.
